tools.name: list_my_va_cases
tools.description:
List the veteran's OWN VA cases (read-only). Requires the veteran's
    personal VetAid agent key in the request's Authorization header
    (Bearer vak_...). Returns each case's id, status, timestamps, and its
    rated / denied / claimed conditions. Only ever returns the key owner's data.

    Returns 'not found' for any case the key owner does not own — no cross-user

tools.name: get_my_vetaid_account
tools.description:
Check the veteran's VetAid account (plan and the legacy credits field).
    Analyses are free for veterans, so nothing needs to be bought before running one.
    Requires the veteran's personal agent key (Bearer vak_...). Read-only.

tools.name: run_my_case_analysis
tools.description:
RUN the full VetAid (the veterans claims tool) analysis pipeline on one of the veteran's OWN cases,
    ON THE VETERAN'S BEHALF. Free for veterans (no credits spent); limited to 5
    agent-run analyses per day. Takes ~5-8 minutes — afterward poll
    get_my_case_analysis(case_id) for the results.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: va_denial_stats, va_condition_intelligence, va_evidence_that_wins · Private data: va_evidence_that_wins · Public sink: va_condition_intelligence, va_manual_changes · Destructive: run_my_case_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: va_denial_stats, va_condition_intelligence, va_evidence_that_wins · Private data: va_evidence_that_wins · Public sink: va_condition_intelligence, va_manual_changes · Destructive: run_my_case_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "va_manual_changes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
